title: SR Backend Developer - Kotlin / Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Como Desenvolvedor Back-end Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento e evolução da plataforma do cliente dentro de uma squad multidisciplinar.

O papel envolve não apenas o desenvolvimento de novas features e produtos, mas também a definição de soluções técnicas estratégicas, garantindo que o software seja robusto, escalável, seguro, performático e de alta qualidade. Também será responsável por compartilhar conhecimento e nivelar o expertise técnico dentro da squad, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e evolução contínua.

Responsabilidades:

* Desenvolver e integrar soluções em parceria com fornecedores e times externos, alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos do cliente.

* Projetar e implementar componentes de alta complexidade, garantindo resiliência, performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

* Atuar com autonomia na entrega de soluções em cenários com múltiplas dependências e ambientes distribuídos.

* Promover boas práticas de engenharia, elevando a maturidade técnica do time e fortalecendo a cultura de qualidade.

* Definir e monitorar métricas que aprimorem governança, eficiência operacional e tomada de decisão orientada a dados.

* Liderar incidentes críticos, direcionando a investigação, correção e análise de causa raiz.

* Otimizar custos e performance das aplicações, garantindo sustentabilidade e eficiência do ecossistema.

* Suportar o time em desafios técnicos complexos, fomentando inovação e melhoria contínua.

* Conduzir code reviews, mentorias e compartilhamento de conhecimento para desenvolvimento técnico da equipe.

Requisitos:

* Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software em arquitetura Cloud Native.

* Experiência com Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.

* Domínio das linguagens Kotlin (principal) e Java.

* Experiência com Microservices, APIs REST e Arquitetura Event-Driven.

* Sólido conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e arquitetura de solução.

* Experiência com Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Vivência em testes automatizados (unitários, integrados e de carga).

* Proficiência em paradigmas de programação, boas práticas, design patterns e Clean Architecture.

* Experiência com serviços de mensageria e cache.

* Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.

Diferenciais:

* Experiência no setor de IGaming, incluindo jogos e plataformas disruptivas.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Java com experiência comprovada em liderança de times técnicos. Procuramos alguém com sólida bagagem em desenvolvimento backend, que conheça os desafios de ambientes de alta performance e que tenha atuado como referência técnica e gestora de equipe.

O(a) profissional ideal sabe equilibrar o desenvolvimento de código com a gestão do time, promovendo boas práticas, apoiando o time e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e performance das soluções.
  • Apoiar o time na tomada de decisões técnicas e resolução de problemas.
  • Realizar code reviews e propor melhorias técnicas contínuas.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções (mão na massa).
  • Conduzir ritos ágeis e colaborar com áreas parceiras.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar o desempenho do time (1:1, feedbacks, planos de desenvolvimento).
  • Estimular boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Acompanhar prazos de entrega de melhorias e correções de bugs, garantindo previsibilidade e alinhamento.
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor soluções com uso de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente voltadas à automação, ganho de produtividade e melhoria de processos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead Java.
  • Sólida experiência com Java 8 ou superior (utilizamos Java 21), além de Spring Boot e Spring MVC.
  • Experiência com Hibernate, JUnit 5, Mockito 2 e Git.
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL).
  • Experiência com Redis.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs.
  • Familiaridade com VueJS, TypeScript e Javascript.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta concorrência, performance e grandes volumes de dados.
  • Habilidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.



Desejáveis:


  • Experiência com análise de logs e troubleshooting.
  • Otimização de queries e análise de performance.
  • Conhecimento em Kibana/APM.
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e PL/SQL.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Ionic + VueJS).
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas: JSP, AngularJS, jQuery.


Ambiente técnico:


  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker.
  • Repositórios no GitHub.
  • IntelliJ Ultimate como IDE.

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Mid-Level Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).
  • Optimize queries and ensure data integrity.


Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Mid-Level Back-end Developer .
  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions.   • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud is a BIG plus;

title: Paralegal
description:
Job Description:

Insight Global is seeking an experienced Paralegal to provide comprehensive legal support for legal cases in the United State, primarily in Oregon. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Oregon procedures, rules, and laws, and will be comfortable working independently in a remote environment. This role involves drafting documents, proofing, and filing, with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare first drafts of legal documents, including pleadings, motions, and correspondence.
  • Review and proof documents for accuracy and compliance with Oregon laws and court rules.
  • Manage case files and maintain organization using case management software.
  • Handle electronic filing and ensure timely submission of documents.
  • Collaborate with attorneys to support case strategy and deadlines.
  • Assist with estate, family, and probate matters when applicable.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of paralegal or legal assistant experience.
  • Proficiency in case management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work remotely and manage tasks independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluent in English.


Preferred Experience

  • Background in family law, estate planning, or probate cases.
  • Familiarity with electronic filing systems and court portals.


The compensation for this role is $6 - $10 USD per hour, which translate to roughly R$39-$50 per hour.

title: SR Backend Developer - Kotlin / Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Como Desenvolvedor Back-end Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento e evolução da plataforma do cliente dentro de uma squad multidisciplinar.

O papel envolve não apenas o desenvolvimento de novas features e produtos, mas também a definição de soluções técnicas estratégicas, garantindo que o software seja robusto, escalável, seguro, performático e de alta qualidade. Também será responsável por compartilhar conhecimento e nivelar o expertise técnico dentro da squad, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e evolução contínua.

Responsabilidades:

* Desenvolver e integrar soluções em parceria com fornecedores e times externos, alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos do cliente.

* Projetar e implementar componentes de alta complexidade, garantindo resiliência, performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

* Atuar com autonomia na entrega de soluções em cenários com múltiplas dependências e ambientes distribuídos.

* Promover boas práticas de engenharia, elevando a maturidade técnica do time e fortalecendo a cultura de qualidade.

* Definir e monitorar métricas que aprimorem governança, eficiência operacional e tomada de decisão orientada a dados.

* Liderar incidentes críticos, direcionando a investigação, correção e análise de causa raiz.

* Otimizar custos e performance das aplicações, garantindo sustentabilidade e eficiência do ecossistema.

* Suportar o time em desafios técnicos complexos, fomentando inovação e melhoria contínua.

* Conduzir code reviews, mentorias e compartilhamento de conhecimento para desenvolvimento técnico da equipe.

Requisitos:

* Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software em arquitetura Cloud Native.

* Experiência com Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.

* Domínio das linguagens Kotlin (principal) e Java.

* Experiência com Microservices, APIs REST e Arquitetura Event-Driven.

* Sólido conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e arquitetura de solução.

* Experiência com Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Vivência em testes automatizados (unitários, integrados e de carga).

* Proficiência em paradigmas de programação, boas práticas, design patterns e Clean Architecture.

* Experiência com serviços de mensageria e cache.

* Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.

Diferenciais:

* Experiência no setor de IGaming, incluindo jogos e plataformas disruptivas.

title: Senior AEM Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior AEM Developer


Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).


This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React/Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, refinement sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Lead complex technical analyses and mentor less‑experienced developers.


Technical Requirements


  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and caching strategies for AEM.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git/GitFlow.
  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).
  • Experience with cloud environments (preferably AWS ).


Preferred Technical Competencies


  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) for cart/checkout flows.
  • Experience with microservices or event‑driven architectures.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.


Behavioral Competencies


  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.


Skill Set Summary


  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git/GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React/Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. title: Arquiteto de negócios
description:

A Engineering é uma companhia global de Tecnologia da Informação e consultoria especializada em Transformação Digital, presente na Europa, América do Norte e América Latina. Há mais de 40 anos no mercado ajudando as empresas a desenvolverem e evoluírem a sua vantagem competitiva por meio de uma abordagem orientada a negócios, colocando a Inteligência Artificial no centro de sua operação, explorando ecossistemas e plataformas digitais e adotando o mindset API First para reconfigurar e inovar a cadeia de valor, gerando novos modelos de negócios e uma melhor experiência do cliente.

Com mais de 1000 colaboradores no Brasil, a Engineering é uma das maiores e mais inovadoras empresas presente no País e considerada um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar.


Desafio

Atuar como elo estratégico entre as áreas de negócio e tecnologia, com foco em Technology Business Management (TBM). Sua missão será garantir que decisões tecnológicas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos financeiros, operacionais e estratégicos da organização, promovendo eficiência, governança e sustentabilidade dos processos.

Esse profissional terá papel fundamental na estruturação de processos, definição de arquiteturas de integração, governança de dados financeiros e tradução de demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas, atuando de forma colaborativa com times de TI, arquitetura técnica e stakeholders corporativos.

title: Clojure Engineer
description:
About the Company

A well-funded, mission-driven fintech company is expanding its remote-first engineering team. Their goal is to scale a digital lending platform that helps borrowers reduce debt — having already refinanced over $6B in loans. They’re hiring senior engineers passionate about building scalable, reliable systems using Clojure .


Key Details

  • Role: Software Engineer (Clojure) – LATAM
  • Type: Contractor (12-month project, full-time)
  • Location: 100% Remote – Open to LATAM candidates only
  • Tech Stack: Clojure (primary), ClojureScript or other front-end techs (React, JS frameworks), Clojure REPL, Idiomatic Clojure
  • Team Culture: Collaborative, low-ego, values ownership, honesty, and functional programming
  • Start Date: Immediate (flexible onboarding available)


What They’ll Do


Build and maintain clean, well-tested APIs in Clojure.

Contribute to scalable, production-grade systems in a lending platform.

Participate actively in a fully remote, collaborative environment.

Take ownership of their work and mentor others when possible.

Provide direct, constructive feedback on PRs.

Leverage AI tools to increase productivity.


What We’re Looking For


At least 5 years of total software engineering experience (does not need to be 5 years of Clojure experience)

Practical, hands-on Clojure experience (not just coursework; building in production environments)

Strong grasp of functional programming concepts (Elixir, Scala, Haskell, or Lisp experience can be relevant if combined with applied Clojure exposure)

English proficiency (can understand with ease virtually everything heard or read)

Comfort with start-up pace and culture; high sense of ownership and accountability

Open communicator who values feedback and collaborative problem-solving

A genuine interest in working for a mission-driven company helping reduce financial burdens for everyday people

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Consultor Técnico - GWS
description:
Quem somos?


Somos parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes na jornada de transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para a implementação de tecnologias em nuvem. Com o apoio do nosso time de especialistas, auxiliamos na migração para ambientes em nuvem, modernização de aplicações, segurança de dados, serviços gerenciados e práticas de FinOps eficientes.


Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, busca inovação e acredita no poder da colaboração, temos a oportunidade ideal para você como Consultor Técnico de GWS.


O seu papel será:

  • Planejar e executar migrações de dados complexas (Exchange, O365, IMAP, etc. para GWS)
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos detalhados (assessments) nos ambientes dos clientes, identificando lacunas de segurança, oportunidades de otimização de licenças e melhorias de fluxo de trabalho.
  • Configurar políticas avançadas de segurança (DLP, Context-Aware Access, Vault, SSO/SAML, Gerenciamento de Dispositivos/MDM).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas administrativas e relatórios (GAM, Apps Script, APIs do Google).
  • Atuar como ponto focal para resolução de incidentes críticos (Nível 3), troubleshooting de e-mail (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) e problemas de sincronização.
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança (Trusted Advisor) para os clientes, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em configurações técnicas no GWS.


Para participar desse processo seletivo, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com Google Workspace: Admin Console, Vault, Mobile Management (MDM)
  • Experiência com protocolos SMTP, DNS, Roteamento de e-mails, SPF, DKIM e DMARC
  • Experiência comprovada em migrações complexas (cenários híbridos, dual delivery)
  • Experiência com GAM / GAMADV-XTD3 (Linha de comando) é essencial para automação e gestão em massa
  • Conhecimento em Google Apps Script, APIs do Google e noções de GCP (Identity Platform)
  • Inglês Intermediário (leitura técnica e abertura de chamados com Google Global são rotina)
  • Certificação Associate Google Workapce Administrador (Obrigatório)

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: English Teacher
description:
Company Overview:


AM Consultoria de Inglês is dedicated to transforming our students' lives through exceptional English language services. We offer more than just English classes; our comprehensive approach includes personalised meetings and continuous follow-ups to ensure student success. Our team is innovative, passionate, and committed to overcoming obstacles for the sake of student development. If you are driven to make a significant impact on your students' lives, we invite you to join our dynamic team. However, if you are merely seeking a teaching position, AM Consultoria de Inglês may not be the right fit for you. We pride ourselves on honesty and transparency from the selection process through to our daily operations. Join us and achieve above-average results together!


Job Characteristics:

Position: ESL Teacher

Location: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Start Date: January 2026

Note: Candidates MUST be available to work Monday through Thursday, 7-9pm.


Responsibilities:

- Plan and deliver engaging, memorable classes.

- Respond to student inquiries via WhatsApp outside of class hours.

- Correct homework and activities on teaching platform.

- Periodically contact students to understand and meet their needs.

- Focus on student results beyond class hours.

- Offer comprehensive support to students in a compassionate manner.

- Pursue continuous professional development.

- Have good quality video and audio. 

- Have a high speed and reliable internet connection. 

- Participate in weekly team meetings (Monday’s at 10am, for 30 minutes)


Qualification:

CELTA, DELTA or TKT certification from Cambridge. 


What we are looking for:

- C2 English proficiency level

- Ability to teach using the communicative approach

- Teachers who bring positve energy to class 

- Strong ability to use online teaching platforms and digital tools effectively

- Ambition and a desire for growth, with the potential to become a leader.

- Humility and a willingness to learn and adapt.

- A positive attitude towards feedback, recognising its importance in improving client impact.

- Willingness to embrace responsibilities and challenges.

- Excellent communication skills to initiate and engage in conversations aimed at service improvement.

- Applicants with significant experience living, working, or studying in an English-speaking environment will be highly considered.


Why join us: 


- Join a growing company with great growth opportunities.

- Enjoy above-average remuneration compared to other ESL schools in Brazil.

- Work with motivated adult learners aiming for better job opportunities.

- Experience a unique teaching methodology distinct from market offerings.

- Contribute to and influence product development and improvements.

- Access professional development opportunities through the company.


We look forward to welcoming passionate and committed professionals to our team. Apply now and be part of a company that truly values and invests in both its students and its team.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Company Description

C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm passionate about helping B2B companies overcome capacity and capability gaps in their go-to-market and revenue operations. By building data-driven outbound growth systems, we enable clients to achieve and exceed pipeline and revenue goals without increasing headcount. Our team provides hands-on support and strategic insights across the entire revenue cycle, from offer design and demand generation to CRM integration and reporting. We collaborate with organizations ranging from startups to enterprises, designing scalable and sustainable systems that drive measurable results.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller. The individual in this role will be responsible for identifying potential leads, initiating outbound calls, engaging prospects, and scheduling appointments for the sales team. Additionally, the role involves managing schedules effectively, maintaining detailed records of interactions, and providing excellent customer service to establish trust and build strong client relationships.


The Role

We're looking for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller to join our team and book qualified meetings for our clients. You'll be on the front lines of outbound, working high-volume calling campaigns across multiple industries. This isn't a role for someone who wants to coast—we run aggressive targets and expect consistent execution.


What You'll Do


Execute + outbound dials daily across client campaigns

Follow proven scripts while adapting to prospect responses in real-time

Book qualified appointments that meet strict ICP criteria

Manage Inbox communication

Collaborate with Campaign Managers and Strategists on targeting and messaging refinements

Hit weekly and monthly meeting quotas consistently



What We're Looking For


Minimum 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting experience in B2B

Proven track record of hitting quota—bring your numbers

Comfortable with rejection and high-volume activity

Clear, professional phone presence

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and professional setup

Coachable with a no-excuses attitude toward performance



Bonus Points


Experience in lead gen agencies or sales development roles

Familiarity with dialers, CRMs, and outbound tech stacks

Background calling into professional services, manufacturing, or mid-market B2B



Compensation

Base + performance bonuses tied to meetings booked. Top performers earn significantly more. Details discussed during interviews.


How to Apply

  • Follow our Linkedin Company Page and our Founder Enzo Carasso before applying so we can see that actually read the entire Job Description.
  • Once you've completed the above - send a connection request to Enzo Carasso with a short note on why you're a fit. Include your last 3 months of performance metrics if available-conversion rates, dials per day, meetings booked. No fluff, just results.

title: English Teacher
description:
Company Overview:


AM Consultoria de Inglês is dedicated to transforming our students' lives through exceptional English language services. We offer more than just English classes; our comprehensive approach includes personalised meetings and continuous follow-ups to ensure student success. Our team is innovative, passionate, and committed to overcoming obstacles for the sake of student development. If you are driven to make a significant impact on your students' lives, we invite you to join our dynamic team. However, if you are merely seeking a teaching position, AM Consultoria de Inglês may not be the right fit for you. We pride ourselves on honesty and transparency from the selection process through to our daily operations. Join us and achieve above-average results together!


Job Characteristics:

Position: ESL Teacher

Location: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Start Date: January 2026

Note: Candidates MUST be available to work Monday through Thursday, 7-9pm.


Responsibilities:

- Plan and deliver engaging, memorable classes.

- Respond to student inquiries via WhatsApp outside of class hours.

- Correct homework and activities on teaching platform.

- Periodically contact students to understand and meet their needs.

- Focus on student results beyond class hours.

- Offer comprehensive support to students in a compassionate manner.

- Pursue continuous professional development.

- Have good quality video and audio. 

- Have a high speed and reliable internet connection. 

- Participate in weekly team meetings (Monday’s at 10am, for 30 minutes)


Qualification:

CELTA, DELTA or TKT certification from Cambridge. 


What we are looking for:

- C2 English proficiency level

- Ability to teach using the communicative approach

- Teachers who bring positve energy to class 

- Strong ability to use online teaching platforms and digital tools effectively

- Ambition and a desire for growth, with the potential to become a leader.

- Humility and a willingness to learn and adapt.

- A positive attitude towards feedback, recognising its importance in improving client impact.

- Willingness to embrace responsibilities and challenges.

- Excellent communication skills to initiate and engage in conversations aimed at service improvement.

- Applicants with significant experience living, working, or studying in an English-speaking environment will be highly considered.


Why join us: 


- Join a growing company with great growth opportunities.

- Enjoy above-average remuneration compared to other ESL schools in Brazil.

- Work with motivated adult learners aiming for better job opportunities.

- Experience a unique teaching methodology distinct from market offerings.

- Contribute to and influence product development and improvements.

- Access professional development opportunities through the company.


We look forward to welcoming passionate and committed professionals to our team. Apply now and be part of a company that truly values and invests in both its students and its team.

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: Software Engineering Team Lead
description:
About us

Wallester is a cutting-edge financial technology company that specializes in providing innovative solutions for businesses seeking to modernize their payment systems. By offering white-label card issuance platforms, seamless integration with existing infrastructure, and comprehensive support for both digital and physical cards, Wallester empowers companies to enhance their financial services and customer experience. Recognized as a leader in the FinTech space, Wallester has earned a reputation for its state-of-the-art technology, security, and scalability. Whether you are a startup or an established enterprise, Wallester delivers flexible, reliable solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of the digital economy.


About the role

As a Software Engineering Team Lead at Wallester, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers and overseeing their work on complex projects. You will plan, organize, and direct the engineering work, ensuring on-time completion and quality outcomes. You will collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to meet project objectives and align engineering goals with business requirements. You will also be involved in developing new processes or procedures for your team, creating training programs, updating job descriptions, or establishing performance metrics.If you are passionate about fintech and payment solutions, have excellent technical skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you!


Technology stack

  • Golang
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • JSON REST API
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linkerd
  • AWS infrastructure
  • Microservice Architecture


What will you do?

  • Guide, coach and grow our team of outstanding Software Engineers
  • Provide technical leadership and direction, bridging the gap between the engineering team and senior management
  • Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to understand project requirements and optimize development resource allocation
  • Manage and prioritize development tasks to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality results
  • Jump into hands-on development when needed, helping the team in solving ongoing challenges
  • Continuously monitor and evaluate code quality and development output, identifying areas for improvement and working collaboratively to fix defects and issues
  • Actively contribute to adopting best practices in Software Engineering, improvement of processes, and team culture


What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in software development using any OOP language (C# / Java / PHP / etc)
  • 2+ years of experience in leading a software engineering team
  • Experience with microservices architecture, REST API, RPC, PostgreSQL, and Docker
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire team members
  • You have good English and communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you can adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Proficient in Agile methodologies and Scrum framework
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated experience in mentoring and coaching team members
  • Experience in working with cloud platforms (Azure / GCP / AWS)


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with DevOps principles and practices
  • Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and technologies for software engineering and delivery
  • Experience in test methodologies and frameworks
  • Experience in financial software development
  • Knowledge of security best practices and standards (OWASP, PCI DSS)
  • Also, a spark in the eyes is always a plus!


We offer

  • Competitive salary
  • The chance to work as part of a highly motivated and talented team
  • Development and career opportunities
  • Supportive and caring Leadership
  • A modern office in the center of Tallinn
  • Fresh fruit, sweets, drinks, and treats
  • Sports compensation
  • Great Team events
  • Free Parking

title: Engenheiro de software
description:
SEU DESAFIO COMO #GTeam

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Software . Você atuará de forma colaborativa, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência à estratégia da Gera e excelência na entrega de valor aos nossos clientes.

Seu papel será fundamental em todo o ciclo de vida do produto, desde o desenho da solução até a entrega em produção, contribuindo ativamente para a evolução contínua dos nossos sistemas.


NO DIA A DIA VOCÊ VAI:

  • Codificar de forma clara, objetiva e sustentável, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento (Clean Code), com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Realizar testes nos próprios desenvolvimentos, garantindo entregas seguras e sem efeitos colaterais em outros pontos do sistema.
  • Contribuir ativamente nos rituais de grooming, ajudando a definir a melhor estratégia de implementação das soluções.
  • Participar da definição de critérios de aceite, identificando possíveis gaps, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria no escopo das atividades.
  • Analisar a causa raiz de bugs e propor soluções definitivas ou alternativas de contorno quando necessário.
  • Atuar no planejamento e decomposição de stories, colaborando para entregas mais eficientes e previsíveis.
  • Apoiar clientes internos e externos em dúvidas técnicas, execução de testes e entendimento de problemas, sempre que solicitado.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre novas tecnologias, propondo melhorias contínuas para os produtos da Gera.
  • Garantir que todos os desenvolvimentos estejam organizados em pacotes de atualização de versão, tanto para homologação quanto para produção.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Private IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Software Engineering Team Lead
description:
About us

Wallester is a cutting-edge financial technology company that specializes in providing innovative solutions for businesses seeking to modernize their payment systems. By offering white-label card issuance platforms, seamless integration with existing infrastructure, and comprehensive support for both digital and physical cards, Wallester empowers companies to enhance their financial services and customer experience. Recognized as a leader in the FinTech space, Wallester has earned a reputation for its state-of-the-art technology, security, and scalability. Whether you are a startup or an established enterprise, Wallester delivers flexible, reliable solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of the digital economy.


About the role

As a Software Engineering Team Lead at Wallester, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers and overseeing their work on complex projects. You will plan, organize, and direct the engineering work, ensuring on-time completion and quality outcomes. You will collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to meet project objectives and align engineering goals with business requirements. You will also be involved in developing new processes or procedures for your team, creating training programs, updating job descriptions, or establishing performance metrics.If you are passionate about fintech and payment solutions, have excellent technical skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you!


Technology stack

  • Golang
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • JSON REST API
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linkerd
  • AWS infrastructure
  • Microservice Architecture


What will you do?

  • Guide, coach and grow our team of outstanding Software Engineers
  • Provide technical leadership and direction, bridging the gap between the engineering team and senior management
  • Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to understand project requirements and optimize development resource allocation
  • Manage and prioritize development tasks to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality results
  • Jump into hands-on development when needed, helping the team in solving ongoing challenges
  • Continuously monitor and evaluate code quality and development output, identifying areas for improvement and working collaboratively to fix defects and issues
  • Actively contribute to adopting best practices in Software Engineering, improvement of processes, and team culture


What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in software development using any OOP language (C# / Java / PHP / etc)
  • 2+ years of experience in leading a software engineering team
  • Experience with microservices architecture, REST API, RPC, PostgreSQL, and Docker
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire team members
  • You have good English and communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you can adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Proficient in Agile methodologies and Scrum framework
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated experience in mentoring and coaching team members
  • Experience in working with cloud platforms (Azure / GCP / AWS)


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with DevOps principles and practices
  • Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and technologies for software engineering and delivery
  • Experience in test methodologies and frameworks
  • Experience in financial software development
  • Knowledge of security best practices and standards (OWASP, PCI DSS)
  • Also, a spark in the eyes is always a plus!


We offer

  • Competitive salary
  • The chance to work as part of a highly motivated and talented team
  • Development and career opportunities
  • Supportive and caring Leadership
  • A modern office in the center of Tallinn
  • Fresh fruit, sweets, drinks, and treats
  • Sports compensation
  • Great Team events
  • Free Parking

description:

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.


We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets. If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English, we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.


This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission, offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation). 
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas. 
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles. 
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro. 
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo. 
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission.
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.
  • Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

Who you are

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Apply

with:

title: Investment Banking Junior Professional
description:
Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world. We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends. If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: Parceiro(a) de Negócios - Energia Renovável
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A iGreen Energy é uma empresa brasileira inovadora de energia sustentável, fundada em 2021 em Uberlândia (MG), com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à energia solar limpa e renovável através de soluções de energia solar compartilhada e assinatura , sem a necessidade de investimento ou instalação de placas, oferecendo descontos na fatura de energia para residências e empresas.


A empresa atua com tecnologia, sustentabilidade e modelos de negócio escaláveis para tornar a energia limpa mais acessível e econômica, usando usinas de energia renovável próprias e de parceiros estratégicos para gerar créditos de energia para os clientes.


Em 2023, a Vibra Energia (antiga BR Distribuidora) adquiriu 50% da iGreen Energy como parte da estratégia de se tornar a maior plataforma multienergia do Brasil, viabilizando investimentos bilionários em capacidade energética para sustentar a expansão nacional, que está a pleno vapor.


Em 2025, a iGreen Energy atingiu uma das melhores notas do Reclame Aqui no setor de energia solar, e recebeu dessa plataforma a premiação de \"Melhor Empresa em Grandes Operações de Energia Solar de 2025\".


Descrição do Cargo

Estamos selecionando empreendedores e profissionais com perfil comercial para atuar na expansão nacional da iGreen Energy, vinculados à equipe comercial da iGreen Energy Vix, licenciada localizada em Vitória, Espírito Santo.


O objetivo é formar líderes que desejam construir um ativo financeiro sólido através de comissões recorrentes e vitalícias, com base nos pagamentos mensais das faturas de energia e telefonia móvel dos clientes conectados.

Devido à operação nacional da empresa, trata-se de uma oportunidade com total liberdade geográfica no setor que mais cresce no Brasil (Energia Renovável e Sustentabilidade).


As responsabilidades incluem prospectar e conectar clientes (pessoa física ou jurídica) às usinas de energia renovável da iGreen Energy e de seus parceiros, sem qualquer investimento por parte dos clientes, além de contribuir para a elaboração de novas estratégias de prospecção para potencializar o negócio e viabilizar o avanço no plano de carreira.


Qualificações

  • Planejamento e Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Habilidade de identificar oportunidades de mercado, criar estratégias de crescimento e construir parcerias comerciais.
  • Comunicação e Negociação: Habilidades sólidas para comunicação e negociação com diferentes stakeholders, assegurando alinhamento e efetividade nas interações com o mercado.
  • Conhecimento Básico e/ou Interesse do Setor de Energia Renovável: Buscamos parceiros que tenham interesse em se tornar especialistas em energia renovável, identificando a solução mais eficiente para cada perfil de cliente.
  • Analítico e Orientado para Resultados: Capacidade de analisar métricas de desempenho e propor melhorias estratégicas para alcançar metas organizacionais.
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência na área comercial e/ou formação superior.


Por que se tornar um parceiro?

  • Modelo escalável: Comissões mensais recorrentes sobre o pagamento das faturas de energia e telefonia móvel da sua carteira de clientes.
  • Produto de alta demanda: Energia é um item essencial para empresas e famílias, representando um importante custo fixo mensal. A solução da iGreen Energy viabiliza pela primeira vez uma alternativa para redução de custos para os clientes conectados, sem qualquer obra ou investimento.
  • Diversidade de serviços: Possibilidade de comercializar projetos de energia fotovoltaica (placas) e conexão de grandes consumidores ao mercado livre de energia, com comissões ainda mais agressivas devido à complexidade das negociações.
  • Autonomia: Agenda totalmente flexível, com atuação 100% autônoma, ideal para quem já possui outra atividade ou busca transição de carreira.
  • Suporte completo: Acesso a CRM próprio, treinamentos semanais ao vivo, plataforma de treinamentos gravados e mentoria direta com a liderança.
  • Plano de carreira: Possibilidade de assumir um papel de liderança na empresa que mais cresce no mercado de energia por assinatura, com mais de 400 mil clientes conectados.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.

  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

Evaluation Process :

description:

Business Development Representative (BDR) – Agência de Marketing


Local: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Remuneração: R$2.000 + R$25 reais por reunião agendada dentro do método BANT

Experiência: Essa não é uma vaga para uma pessoa júnior


Você é movido(a) por resultados, tem habilidade com comunicação e quer crescer na área comercial? Na nossa agência de marketing, buscamos um(a) BDR com perfil proativo, organizado e com vontade de crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.



O que você vai fazer por aqui:

Realizar prospecção ativa de novos leads qualificados, utilizando canais como e-mail, telefone, WhatsApp e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram).

Criar e nutrir listas semanais de leads com base no perfil ideal de cliente (ICP).

Realizar abordagens consultivas com foco em entender as necessidades e dores dos potenciais clientes.

Qualificar os leads com base em critérios definidos e agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers).

Manter o CRM e planilhas atualizado com as interações e status de cada lead.

Trabalhar alinhado(a) às estratégias de marketing para maximizar o aproveitamento dos leads outbound.

Testar abordagens, mensagens e sequências de contato para aprimorar a taxa de conversão.

Analisar e acompanhar métricas de desempenho como taxa de resposta, conversão e reuniões agendadas.
