Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Organização e disciplina para lidar com rotinas e metas.

Familiaridade com CRMs e planilhas

Interesse por vendas, marketing digital e crescimento em startups ou agências.

Ambição de crescimento

Conhecimento em prospecção outbound via cold call


Diferenciais:

Experiência em agência de marketing ou com vendas de serviços digitais.

Conhecimento básico em técnicas como SPIN Selling ou rapport.

Noções de funil de vendas, qualificação de leads e follow-up.


Benefícios e Cultura:

Trabalho remoto com flexibilidade de horário.

Treinamentos internos e acesso a cursos da área comercial e de marketing.

Ambiente colaborativo, com feedbacks constantes

Participação em projetos desafiadores com marcas de diversos segmentos.

Bonificação por resultado.


Metas:

Sua meta vai ser prospecção de 100 empresas semanais, marcando entre 25 a 35 reuniões por mês.

title: Business Development Associate
description:
We’re hiring: Business Development Associate (BDA - Entry Level)


At Excent Capital Ltd., we’re building a high-performance, globally minded team.


We are a multi-regulated investment broker with international presence and offices in London, Seychelles, St. Vincent, Brazil, and our LATAM headquarters in Mexico City. Our mission is simple: to provide clients and investors with a secure, technology-driven platform to operate in global financial markets while creating real career opportunities for ambitious professionals.


This role is designed as your first step into professional sales and financial markets . No previous finance background is required, we train you from day one.


The Role

  • As a Business Development Associate, you’ll be part of our commercial engine, working closely with senior Business Development Managers and gaining hands-on experience across LATAM, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
  • If you’re a recent graduate with 1–2 years of experience in sales or commercial roles involving direct client interaction, this might be the role for you.


You will:

  • Prospect and hunt leads across multiple regions and markets.
  • Execute multichannel outbound outreach and conduct discovery calls.
  • Support the sales team with tailored commercial materials.
  • Manage and update CRM data with discipline and precision.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales and Customer Service to support closures and follow-ups.


What We’re Looking For:

  • 1 –2 years of experience (internships or part-time roles are welcome).
  • Recent graduates or final-year students in business, marketing, economics, or related fields.
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Interest in sales, business development, and financial markets.
  • High energy, discipline, and willingness to learn.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive net monthly salary.
  • Clear career path for your professional growth.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonus
  • Working hours: Monday to Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
  • Short Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.


Competitive package of superior benefits, including:

  • Health insurance
  • 22 days of time off per year
  • International business trips
  • Totalpass
  • Apple equipment
  • Parking at the building


On-site role in Cidade Monções, São Paulo - SP.


If you’re looking for your first serious professional opportunity , want to learn sales in an international company, and are ready to grow fast, we’d love to meet you.

title: Product Designer Jr (AI / No-Code / App Builder)
description:
A Esfera é um dos estúdios de produtos mais prestigiados do Brasil, com atuação exclusiva no mercado americano, especialmente na Califórnia. Com um histórico de mais de 200 projetos concluídos e mais de $50M captados para nossos clientes, unimos design a um processo de desenvolvimento ultra-acelerado. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, criando soluções para gigantes como Microsoft, Google e Meta. Se você é movido por desafios, quer trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta e impactar o mercado digital com interfaces e apps de alto nível, seu lugar é aqui!


O que você fará?

Você será responsável por transformar ideias em produtos digitais reais, atuando desde a concepção até a construção e lançamento de apps. Na Esfera, design não é só visual: você desenha pensando em execução, valida rápido e constrói soluções funcionais em ciclos recordes com apoio de ferramentas modernas e IA.


Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Construir MVPs e aplicativos utilizando ferramentas como Lovable, Cursor e outras soluções AI / no-code / low-code;
  • Participar do processo completo: ideação, validação, build e launch;
  • Gerenciar suas próprias tarefas e prazos com autonomia, garantindo a excelência em cada entrega;
  • Transformar ideias complexas em interfaces intuitivas e prontas para o mercado;
  • Garantir que cada entrega reflita o padrão de excelência da Esfera, focando sempre no sucesso e na geração de receita para nossos clientes;
  • Identificar gargalos técnicos e propor soluções rápidas;
  • Colaboração ativa com a equipe em reuniões de alinhamento e brainstorming.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia com Figma;
  • Experiência prática como Product Designer, UX/UI Designer ou UX Engineer;
  • Domínio ou forte interesse em ferramentas AI / no-code / low-code;
  • INDISPENSÁVEL inglês Intermediário;
  • Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo (o cenário de IA muda toda semana);
  • Sólido conhecimento em UX e Produto Digital;
  • Proatividade e facilidade em trabalhar em equipe de forma remota.


Diferenciais:

  • Mentalidade de builder (gosta de executar, não só projetar);
  • Experiência prévia com Lovable, Cursor ou ferramentas similares;
  • Noções de lógica de programação, APIs ou desenvolvimento front-end;
  • Já ter lançado produtos reais (web ou app stores);
  • Interesse genuíno em novas modelos de construção de produto (AI-first);
  • Experiência em startups ou ambientes de construção rápida.


O que oferecemos?

  • Contratação PJ;
  • Plano de carreira e crescimento acelerado em um mercado global;
  • Horário semi flexível: 9h-13h (fixo) + 4h flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Encontro com o time anual 100% custeada pela Esfera;
  • Autonomia no trabalho e ambiente dinâmico;
  • Contrato inicial de experiência: 3 meses.


Venha fazer parte da Esfera e ajude a moldar o futuro do desenvolvimento de produtos!

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain high-quality Python libraries and modules used by enterprise clients worldwide.
  • Ensure Python libraries and modules are secure and free from vulnerabilities in both code and dependencies.
  • Define, promote, and enforce Python coding conventions, linters, static analysis, and architectural guardrails.
  • Perform (and lead) code reviews that catch design or performance issues early.
  • Build internal libraries, shared modules, or tooling that abstract common patterns and increase team velocity.
  • Work collaboratively with Product, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable implementations.
  • Profile, monitor, and optimize performance, memory usage, and resource consumption of Python services.
  • Contribute to API design, interface contracts, data models, and integration strategies.
  • Stay current in the Python ecosystem and introduce innovations or best practices where appropriate.
  • Document high-level architecture, module contracts, and design rationale.
  • Mentor development teams via pair programming, review feedback, internal sessions, and guidance.


Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Professional experience (5+ years) with Python development, with a track record of delivering large-scale projects.
  • Deep mastery of Python, including language internals, decorators, concurrency, threading/async, and memory management.
  • Experience designing, creating, and maintaining Python packages.
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks (pytest or unittest), CI/CD pipelines, and package managers (uv, conda, pip).
  • Publications and contributions to open-source Python libraries and community involvement (PyPI).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, system thinking, and debugging large systems.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal/written).
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Advanced.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with asynchronous frameworks, event loops, or systems like Celery, asyncio, RPC frameworks, or message brokers.
  • Experience with Rust and integrating Python with Rust.
  • Solid experience with relational (e.g. PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases, ORM tools, and schema design.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers (Docker), and deployment orchestration.
  • Relevant hands-on experience with automation projects.
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment.


Escolaridade mínima: Ensino Superior - Concluído

We offer services such as strategic UI/UX design, embedded design partnerships, product interface design for SaaS dashboards and AI products, UX audits, and MVP design sprints. Responsibilities include managing logistics, facilitating inspections, tracking project progress, and ensuring alignment with client goals and timelines. The Project Manager will serve as the key liaison between design teams and clients, ensuring seamless communication and successful project outcomes.


Qualifications

  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, Hands-on professional;

title: Investment Banking Junior Professional
description:
Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world. We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends. If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.

title: Integration Engineer - Developer n8n Specialist
description:
Location: Remote | Industry: Retail / E-commerce Technology


About the Mission

We are leading a strategic technological transformation at the heart of our retail operations. We are migrating our core automation and integration layer from Workato to a self-hosted n8n platform. This isn't just an update; it's a complete rebuild for scale, control, and performance.

We are looking for the lead engineer to own this critical migration and shape the future of how our enterprise systems—like RetailPro, SAP, Oracle, and Amazon S3—communicate and automate.

If you are a developer who thrives on complex integrations, enjoys the challenge of platform migration, and wants to see your architecture decisions power a high-volume business, this is your role.


Your Core Challenge

You will be the technical owner of the \"Workato to n8n\" migration project. Your primary mission is to design, execute, and optimize the new automation ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Migration: Architect and execute the full migration of complex automation workflows from Workato to a self-hosted n8n environment.
  • Build Enterprise Integrations: Develop, maintain, and optimize high-volume, reliable workflows connecting critical systems: RetailPro, SAP (ECC/S4HANA), Amazon S3, Oracle DB, Snowflake, and various APIs.
  • Ensure Robust Connectivity: Design and implement secure, reliable connectivity solutions between our n8n platform and on-premise systems.
  • Champion Reliability: Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve the performance and uptime of all automated processes.
  • Own the Platform: Make key decisions on the n8n deployment, scaling, and best practices, acting as the subject-matter expert.


Who We Are Looking For

Must-Have Skills (Non-negotiable):

  • 3+ years of hands-on, production experience with n8n. You have built, deployed, and maintained complex workflows.
  • Proven experience with self-hosted n8n deployments. You understand the infrastructure, scaling, and security aspects.
  • Direct experience migrating from one iPaaS platform to another, preferably from Workato, Zapier, or Make. You know the pitfalls and patterns of platform migration.
  • Strong understanding of secure integration patterns for on-premise systems (e.g., via SSH tunnels, VPN, agents).
  • Experience with event-driven and file-based automation architectures.

Highly Valued Skills (Nice-to-Have):

  • Development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for writing custom n8n nodes or logic.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, IAM).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for n8n deployments.
  • Familiarity with RetailPro, SAP B1/ECC, or Oracle E-Business Suite from an integration perspective.


  • Why You Should ApplyOwn a Strategic Project: This is not a maintenance role. You will own and define a migration that is critical to business operations.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Work on challenging integrations that move data between the core systems of a major retailer.
  • Technical Autonomy: You will be the expert. We trust you to make the right technical decisions and shape the platform's future.
  • Growth & Impact: Your work will directly influence operational efficiency and provide visible value across the company.
  • Modern Stack: Work with a leading, developer-friendly automation tool (n8n) in a modern, cloud-aware context.


Salary: 5000USD

title: Analista de Testes automatizados - PL
description:
Código da vaga: 56796


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Analista de Testes automatizados - PL , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Automação de testes para aplicações web e APIs, utilizando RestAssured, Selenium, JUnit e Jest , incluindo testes de integração, regressão e comportamento (BDD ).
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de frameworks e scripts de automação em Java e Python , com projetos estruturados em Maven .
  • Atuação em ambientes de CI/CD , colaborando na implementação e evolução de pipelines de integração e entrega contínua.
  • Execução e validação de dados por meio de queries SQL , apoiando testes funcionais e de integração.
  • Contribuição para a melhoria contínua dos processos e práticas de Qualidade de Software (QA) , em colaboração com times de desenvolvimento..


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Software Developer MERN Stack
description:
Type: Full‑time/ Remote

Contract: Independent contractor (Canada‑based company)

Non-negotiable requirement: Advanced English

Compensation Range: $2500 - $3500 USD/mo


Ready to Apply? We value thoughtful applications over quick submissions. Please send short introduction video to j Include any relevant experience or examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in building things.


Alternatively, you will receive an automated email to prepare a one-way video interview as the first step of the hiring process.


We are now building a cutting-edge, high-performing software delivery team to drive the innovation and technological success of our brands. As our next key hire, we are looking for a Senior Software developer to join us. You will initially join an existing SaaS development team to bring the product in-house, and then proceed to contribute to a number of new and exciting AI-native software initiatives across our portfolio of brands.


To succeed in this role, you must have:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Experience with the MERN stack and at least 1 other mainstream technology stack
  • Proficiency in a minimum of two of the following languages: Javascript, Typescript, PHP, Python, C/C++, C#, Go
  • Great communication skills in English (both written & spoken)
  • Impeccable attention to detail
  • Experience with Scrum and agile software delivery
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI to enhance your impact, coupled with a good understanding of its limitations


To make you a great match for what we’re looking for, you’ll have:

  • Great problem solving skills
  • Experience building and working with Docker containers
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with cloud platforms
  • Understanding of information security best practices
  • Proven ability to work both independently as an individual contributor and collaboratively as part of a team
  • The ability to overlap with the ET timezone (UTC-5) for at least 4 normal business hours


We offer:

  • A competitive salary reflective of your abilities and potential
  • The unique opportunity to join and help shape a brand new team within an established global company
  • Clear professional development and career progression pathways
  • A fully remote working environment

title: Analista de Conteúdo (Pleno)
description:
Sobre a HIKE:

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira & transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.


Sobre a vaga:

Você será responsável por planejar, criar e produzir o conteúdo da HIKE com consistência e inteligência conectando estratégia e conteúdo nativo digital. Na prática, é quem garante que a HIKE tenha presença forte nas redes, com conteúdo que constrói nossa reputação, traduz os nossos cases e provoca conversas relevantes.


Responsabilidades:


  • Estratégia de conteúdo (HIKE): Desenvolver e gerenciar a estratégia editorial da HIKE (pilares, narrativas, formatos, cadência, calendário e critérios de qualidade), conectando objetivos da marca e posicionamento.


  • Criação de conteúdo: Criar conteúdos que reforcem autoridade e diferenciação (cases, insights, threads e conteúdos opinativos), traduzindo o trabalho da HIKE com clareza e repertório.


  • Produção de conteúdo nativo: Gravar e editar conteúdos nativos (Reels/Stories/TikTok) garantindo ritmo, linguagem e qualidade de execução alinhados à HIKE.


  • Gestão de freelas (design/motion): Selecionar, briefar e acompanhar freelas de criação (design e motion), garantindo organização, alinhamento criativo, prazos e qualidade final das entregas.


  • Gestão de redes sociais: Gerenciar os perfis da HIKE (Instagram e LinkedIn), incluindo planejamento, publicação, organização de pautas, interface com time interno e manutenção do calendário.


  • Performance e insights: Acompanhar métricas de conteúdo (alcance, engajamento, retenção, crescimento, cliques e saves), consolidar resultados e apresentar aprendizados e recomendações práticas.


Requisitos da vaga:


  • Experiência prévia com conteúdo nativo para redes sociais (da estratégia à execução).
  • Capacidade de criar conteúdo com pensamento estratégico (estrutura, narrativa, clareza e repertório).
  • Experiência com produção e edição de conteúdo nativo (Reels/Stories/TikTok) com consistência e qualidade.
  • Organização para operar calendário, múltiplas entregas e interface com freelas/fornecedores.
  • Capacidade analítica para acompanhar métricas, gerar insights e propor ajustes com base em dados.


Nível do cargo:

Pleno I


Remuneração:

R$ 4.000,00/mês


Benefícios:

Caju (R$ 330/mês)

Gympass


Início:

Fevereiro de 2026

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.


We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets. If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English, we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.


This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission, offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation). 
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas. 
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles. 
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro. 
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo. 
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission.
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.
  • Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity


Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work



  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.


Oportunidade


Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.


Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.


Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.


Condições de Trabalho

  • Pacote de compensações competitivas
  • Ambiente de trabalho estimulante e colaborativo
  • Trabalho remoto

description:

title: Closer de Vendas
description:
CLOSER DE VENDAS - AGÊNCIA DE PUBLICIDADE


Quem nós somos:

Somos uma agência de publicidade e marketing, com origem no Design. Temos diversos clientes do setor de tecnologia e entretenimento e desenvolvemos desde trabalhos para redes sociais, até design gráfico, branding, 3D, entre outros. Atendemos projetos do Brasil e do mundo de forma totalmente remota e digital.


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos buscando um Closer de Vendas - Agência de Publicidade para integrar nossa equipe de vendas. Este profissional será responsável por identificar e qualificar oportunidades de negócios, ajudando a construir e alimentar nosso funil de vendas.



Responsabilidades:

  • Realiza prospecção ativa de novos clientes por meio de ligações, e-mails, redes sociais e videochamadas;
  • Gerar propostas e identificar as necessidades dos clientes em potencial;
  • Agendar e realizar reuniões com clientes;
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de desempenho, buscando continuamente melhorar os processos.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência em vendas, preferencialmente em agência de publicidade, marketing ou design;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de lidar com rejeições;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e de prospecção;
  • Dominar técnicas de vendas;
  • Excelente performance em fechamento de negócios.



Informações Extras:

  • Disponibilidade para atuar em período integral;
  • Possuir computador com câmera, fone de ouvido, conexão de Internet estável para o trabalho home office;
  • Salário base + comissões (em caso de batimento de metas) + bonificações;
  • Horário: Segunda à Quinta - 08:00 às 18:00; Sexta - 08:00 às 17:00.

title: LATAM Customer Success Manager
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Overview:

Prometheus Group’s Customer Success Department is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our growing team. In this role you will be responsible for understanding our customer base, increasing customer engagement and retention. You will connect with our customer base daily to identify key stakeholders and establish a collaborative relationship between our organization and our customers’. We’re looking for individuals who share our passion for understanding our customers’ needs, anticipating gaps, and elaborating engagement strategies to provide solutions. In this position you will work across departments with our Sales, Support, Development, Marketing, Finance, and Deliveries teams alike to nurture our customer base and stimulate the growth of our Prometheus Platform with each customer.


Responsibilities:

  • Forge relationships with new customers and understand their objectives
  • From a consultative approach, develop an engagement strategy and plan for achieving customer objectives in any part of the customer journey to ensure churn prevention
  • Represent the voice of the customer to provide input into every core product, marketing, and sales process
  • Monitor customer usage, adoption, and customer health metrics
  • Continually work with customers per prescribed engagement model to support ongoing successful adoption of the Prometheus Platform and to drive additional value throughout the lifetime of the subscription term
  • Perform periodic business reviews with customers (virtual and on-site) to confirm satisfaction, resolve technical issues, and continually drive successful product adoption
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that will improve the overall customer experience and lead to greater satisfaction and loyalty among customers
  • Leverage new and existing tools, processes and best practices to ensure customers are realizing the greatest possible value from the Prometheus Platform
  • Be proactive when conducting discovery with customers on opportunities and handle any objections to ensure predictability of successfully closing those opportunities
  • Generate and manage your assigned account pipeline via weekly and daily forecasts as well as reviewing with your direct manager
  • Measured on engagement volume
  • Maintain impeccable administration of your accounts in the Company's CRM


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience and education preferred
  • Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese
  • Experience with MS Office (Word and Excel)
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM preferred
  • Familiarity with standard concepts, practices and procedures with software implementation and rollout
  • Ambitious self-starter with high energy, passion, drive, and motivation
  • Excellent verbal and written communications
  • Excellent time management and organization skills
  • Superior customer service skills
  • Strong collaborative and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision
  • Ability to build rapport with customers via phone, email and video conferencing


What’ll make you stand out?!

  • ERP system experience (Oracle, SAP)
  • Experience in the software industry
  • Functional understanding of plant maintenance workflow, including both routine and shut down/turnaround maintenance.
  • Prior Customer Success Management is a plus


Prometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Integration Engineer - Developer n8n Specialist
description:
Location: Remote | Industry: Retail / E-commerce Technology


About the Mission

We are leading a strategic technological transformation at the heart of our retail operations. We are migrating our core automation and integration layer from Workato to a self-hosted n8n platform. This isn't just an update; it's a complete rebuild for scale, control, and performance.

We are looking for the lead engineer to own this critical migration and shape the future of how our enterprise systems—like RetailPro, SAP, Oracle, and Amazon S3—communicate and automate.

If you are a developer who thrives on complex integrations, enjoys the challenge of platform migration, and wants to see your architecture decisions power a high-volume business, this is your role.


Your Core Challenge

You will be the technical owner of the \"Workato to n8n\" migration project. Your primary mission is to design, execute, and optimize the new automation ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Migration: Architect and execute the full migration of complex automation workflows from Workato to a self-hosted n8n environment.
  • Build Enterprise Integrations: Develop, maintain, and optimize high-volume, reliable workflows connecting critical systems: RetailPro, SAP (ECC/S4HANA), Amazon S3, Oracle DB, Snowflake, and various APIs.
  • Ensure Robust Connectivity: Design and implement secure, reliable connectivity solutions between our n8n platform and on-premise systems.
  • Champion Reliability: Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve the performance and uptime of all automated processes.
  • Own the Platform: Make key decisions on the n8n deployment, scaling, and best practices, acting as the subject-matter expert.


Who We Are Looking For

Must-Have Skills (Non-negotiable):

  • 3+ years of hands-on, production experience with n8n. You have built, deployed, and maintained complex workflows.
  • Proven experience with self-hosted n8n deployments. You understand the infrastructure, scaling, and security aspects.
  • Direct experience migrating from one iPaaS platform to another, preferably from Workato, Zapier, or Make. You know the pitfalls and patterns of platform migration.
  • Strong understanding of secure integration patterns for on-premise systems (e.g., via SSH tunnels, VPN, agents).
  • Experience with event-driven and file-based automation architectures.

Highly Valued Skills (Nice-to-Have):

  • Development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for writing custom n8n nodes or logic.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, IAM).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for n8n deployments.
  • Familiarity with RetailPro, SAP B1/ECC, or Oracle E-Business Suite from an integration perspective.


  • Why You Should ApplyOwn a Strategic Project: This is not a maintenance role. You will own and define a migration that is critical to business operations.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Work on challenging integrations that move data between the core systems of a major retailer.
  • Technical Autonomy: You will be the expert. We trust you to make the right technical decisions and shape the platform's future.
  • Growth & Impact: Your work will directly influence operational efficiency and provide visible value across the company.
  • Modern Stack: Work with a leading, developer-friendly automation tool (n8n) in a modern, cloud-aware context.


Salary: 5000USD

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer


We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability stack, and platform operations. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure reliable delivery, stability, and scalability of our systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI.
  • Manage and evolve our GitOps workflows using FluxCD for Kubernetes deployments.
  • Maintain and enhance our Kubernetes clusters, ensuring reliability, security and scalability.
  • Develop automation tools and services using Python.
  • Manage and support a wide range of open-source services.
  • Administer and secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise platform performance and reliability.
  • Work across teams to enhance observability, logging, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Manage and maintain Linux-based environments and infrastructure.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and support connectivity-related issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and automation-first culture.


Core Technical Skills

  • Proven track record with GitLab CI for CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling, ideally FluxCD.
  • Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.

  • Experience with open-source services such as, Elastic stack, Prometheus & Alertmanager, Fluentd, Kafka, Consul.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:

Evaluation Process :

description:

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full-Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities, an aptitude for learning new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, reducing operating costs, saving time, and increasing profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on Linux, nginx (engine x), fpm, and mostly MySQL
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning



REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and Linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences, must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to ensure deadlines are met with high quality
  • Team player with practical communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change, with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


PREFERRED (But NOT Required):

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka \"Engine X\")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with the upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


What YOU Get!

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Analista de Negócios (Treinamento)
description:
A GP Strategies Corporation é um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de transformação de talentos. Ao oferecer soluções premiadas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajudamos as organizações a se transformarem por meio de seu pessoal e a alcançarem mudanças significativas. A GP Strategies forneceu suas soluções inovadoras de consultoria, serviços de aprendizado e tecnologia de talentos para mais de 6.000 organizações em todo o mundo.


Com base em nossa experiência global de trabalho em milhares de projetos e iniciativas nos últimos 55 anos, aprendemos que relacionamentos, negócios, trabalho, inovação, estratégia e transformação têm tudo a ver com pessoas. E, em poucas palavras, a GP Strategies é o nosso pessoal: uma extensa rede global de especialistas em aprendizado. Saiba mais em


Estamos buscando um Analista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios que promova e venda os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela GP Strategies Corporation a clientes novos e existentes.


Esquema de trabalho: Remoto - com viagens.


Principais atividades:


  • Utiliza o conhecimento das competências e da estratégia de negócios da empresa para garantir novas oportunidades de negócios com clientes existentes e potenciais, de acordo com os planos e programas de marketing da empresa.
  • Identifica parcerias importantes que impulsionarão os negócios futuros.
  • Negocia acordos comerciais importantes.
  • Estabelece análises competitivas, identifica tendências e articula o impacto potencial em áreas específicas do negócio.
  • Apresenta análises de casos de negócios à gerência executiva.
  • Trabalha com os clientes atuais para identificar e atender às necessidades, resolver reclamações e verificar a satisfação do cliente.
  • Mantém contato frequente com as operações relativas às obrigações contratuais atuais e trabalha com a equipe para estabelecer ferramentas de comunicação eficazes.
  • Trabalha em conjunto com outras unidades de negócios no que se refere ao desenvolvimento de negócios e iniciativas da empresa.
  • Trabalha em estreita colaboração com outros funcionários de desenvolvimento de negócios para garantir que os principais objetivos e prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Participa de convenções, seminários e outras atividades comerciais para promover a GP junto a clientes, clientes potenciais e fornecedores.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência anterior em desenvolvimento de negócios, vendas B2B ou gestão de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento de análise de mercado, tendências e cenário competitivo.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e software de gestão comercial.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Espanhol avançado será uma vantagem.
  • Experiência anterior na área comercial de consultoria - desejável.


Outras habilidades:


  • Fortes habilidades de negociação para estabelecer acordos comerciais vantajosos.
  • Capacidade de construir parcerias estratégicas e identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Mentalidade analítica para apresentar estudos de caso e análises de viabilidade à liderança.
  • Orientado para resultados, com foco em metas comerciais e satisfação do cliente.


Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! title: Parceiro(a) de Negócios - Energia Renovável
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A iGreen Energy é uma empresa brasileira inovadora de energia sustentável, fundada em 2021 em Uberlândia (MG), com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à energia solar limpa e renovável através de soluções de energia solar compartilhada e assinatura , sem a necessidade de investimento ou instalação de placas, oferecendo descontos na fatura de energia para residências e empresas.


A empresa atua com tecnologia, sustentabilidade e modelos de negócio escaláveis para tornar a energia limpa mais acessível e econômica, usando usinas de energia renovável próprias e de parceiros estratégicos para gerar créditos de energia para os clientes.


Em 2023, a Vibra Energia (antiga BR Distribuidora) adquiriu 50% da iGreen Energy como parte da estratégia de se tornar a maior plataforma multienergia do Brasil, viabilizando investimentos bilionários em capacidade energética para sustentar a expansão nacional, que está a pleno vapor.


Em 2025, a iGreen Energy atingiu uma das melhores notas do Reclame Aqui no setor de energia solar, e recebeu dessa plataforma a premiação de \"Melhor Empresa em Grandes Operações de Energia Solar de 2025\".


Descrição do Cargo

Estamos selecionando empreendedores e profissionais com perfil comercial para atuar na expansão nacional da iGreen Energy, vinculados à equipe comercial da iGreen Energy Vix, licenciada localizada em Vitória, Espírito Santo.


O objetivo é formar líderes que desejam construir um ativo financeiro sólido através de comissões recorrentes e vitalícias, com base nos pagamentos mensais das faturas de energia e telefonia móvel dos clientes conectados.

Devido à operação nacional da empresa, trata-se de uma oportunidade com total liberdade geográfica no setor que mais cresce no Brasil (Energia Renovável e Sustentabilidade).


As responsabilidades incluem prospectar e conectar clientes (pessoa física ou jurídica) às usinas de energia renovável da iGreen Energy e de seus parceiros, sem qualquer investimento por parte dos clientes, além de contribuir para a elaboração de novas estratégias de prospecção para potencializar o negócio e viabilizar o avanço no plano de carreira.


Qualificações

  • Planejamento e Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Habilidade de identificar oportunidades de mercado, criar estratégias de crescimento e construir parcerias comerciais.
  • Comunicação e Negociação: Habilidades sólidas para comunicação e negociação com diferentes stakeholders, assegurando alinhamento e efetividade nas interações com o mercado.
  • Conhecimento Básico e/ou Interesse do Setor de Energia Renovável: Buscamos parceiros que tenham interesse em se tornar especialistas em energia renovável, identificando a solução mais eficiente para cada perfil de cliente.
  • Analítico e Orientado para Resultados: Capacidade de analisar métricas de desempenho e propor melhorias estratégicas para alcançar metas organizacionais.
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência na área comercial e/ou formação superior.


Por que se tornar um parceiro?

  • Modelo escalável: Comissões mensais recorrentes sobre o pagamento das faturas de energia e telefonia móvel da sua carteira de clientes.
  • Produto de alta demanda: Energia é um item essencial para empresas e famílias, representando um importante custo fixo mensal. A solução da iGreen Energy viabiliza pela primeira vez uma alternativa para redução de custos para os clientes conectados, sem qualquer obra ou investimento.
  • Diversidade de serviços: Possibilidade de comercializar projetos de energia fotovoltaica (placas) e conexão de grandes consumidores ao mercado livre de energia, com comissões ainda mais agressivas devido à complexidade das negociações.
  • Autonomia: Agenda totalmente flexível, com atuação 100% autônoma, ideal para quem já possui outra atividade ou busca transição de carreira.
  • Suporte completo: Acesso a CRM próprio, treinamentos semanais ao vivo, plataforma de treinamentos gravados e mentoria direta com a liderança.
  • Plano de carreira: Possibilidade de assumir um papel de liderança na empresa que mais cresce no mercado de energia por assinatura, com mais de 400 mil clientes conectados.

title: Investment Banking Junior Professional
description:

Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world. We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends. If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Us

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer experienced in Azure Cloud operations to join our remote-first engineering team. This position suits someone who thrives in building and maintaining large-scale infrastructure, ensuring performance and reliability, and communicating effectively with both technical and client teams.


Your Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Radity, you will manage, optimize, and automate Azure-based infrastructure. You will ensure the smooth operation of production systems, focusing on scalability, security, and monitoring. You will also work closely with developers and clients to provide technical clarity and maintain high service reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure in Azure Cloud, including AKS environments.
  • Automate provisioning and system management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Oversee system monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning using Datadog and native Azure tools.
  • Manage GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration and delivery.
  • Implement best practices for cost optimization, networking, and cloud security.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to support operational needs and technical planning.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, incident response, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Review application configurations and read Python-based code when required to support deployments.


What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Operations.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with clients.
  • Strong expertise in Azure Cloud, AKS, and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with Python, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and performance optimization.
  • A proactive and reliable approach to problem solving and ownership.


What’s In It for You

  • A remote-first position with flexible working hours.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced Azure technologies and global-scale systems.
  • Collaboration with international teams and direct client interaction.
  • A supportive environment focused on growth, quality, and innovation.
  • Opportunities for professional certifications and technical development.

title: Account Executive
description:
Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market , while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM .


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.


Main Responsibilities


1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing


  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).


2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io, CloudTalk, Instantly
  • Comm: Google Meet, Loom (for video demos), Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Account Executive
description:

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform , helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.

We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets . If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English , we want you on board.

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle , from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.

﻿
