title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Especialista em Kafka & CDC (Debezium)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium , para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC.


Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes Apache Kafka em produção , incluindo instalação, upgrades, expansão de clusters e troubleshooting.
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect.


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Mid-Level Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. The professional will be responsible for building scalable solutions, maintaining engineering best practices, contributing to technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and agile environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS .
  • Ensure clean, scalable, and well-documented code.


Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).
  • Optimize queries and ensure data integrity.


Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Write automated tests to guarantee quality and stability.
  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Collaborate with multifunctional teams (product, design, QA, front‑end).
  • Communicate requirements and delivery status clearly.


Nice-to-Have Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Mid-Level Back-end Developer .
  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

Descrição da posição:


Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Sênior especializado(a) nos módulos de Inventory, Cost Management e Order Management, para atuar em projetos estratégicos, com foco em implementação, melhorias, estabilização e suporte evolutivo.


O(a) profissional terá papel protagonista no entendimento das necessidades do negócio, definição de soluções, desenho funcional, validação com usuários e sustentação de processos críticos.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos funcionais e entendimento de processos de negócio.
  • Desenhar soluções aderentes aos módulos Inventory, Cost Management e OM.
  • Participar de atividades de implementação, configuração, testes funcionais e validação com usuários.
  • Apoiar usuários-chave e áreas de negócio em incidentes, melhorias e estabilização do ambiente.
  • Documentar soluções, fluxos funcionais e decisões técnicas.
  • Garantir boas práticas, governança de processos e aderência às políticas do cliente.
  • Interagir com equipes técnicas, funcionais e stakeholders de negócio, garantindo alinhamento e qualidade nas entregas.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Consultor Funcional Sênior em Oracle ERP (Cloud ou EBS).
  • Conhecimento avançado nos módulos:
  • Inventory
  • Cost Management
  • Order Management (OM)
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação, rollout, melhorias e suporte funcional.
  • Vivência em análise de requisitos, desenho funcional e testes integrados.
  • Português fluente (mandatório).


Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em integrações com outros módulos ERP e soluções externas.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de governança e metodologias de projeto.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura técnica.


Soft Skills (Competências Comportamentais):


  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de processos.
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e estruturada.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Autonomia na tomada de decisão e senso de responsabilidade sobre entregas.
  • Perfil consultivo, com foco em solução e orientação ao cliente.
  • Organização, disciplina e atenção a detalhes.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e de alta complexidade.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Software Engineering Team Lead
description:
About us

Wallester is a cutting-edge financial technology company that specializes in providing innovative solutions for businesses seeking to modernize their payment systems. By offering white-label card issuance platforms, seamless integration with existing infrastructure, and comprehensive support for both digital and physical cards, Wallester empowers companies to enhance their financial services and customer experience. Recognized as a leader in the FinTech space, Wallester has earned a reputation for its state-of-the-art technology, security, and scalability. Whether you are a startup or an established enterprise, Wallester delivers flexible, reliable solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of the digital economy.


About the role

As a Software Engineering Team Lead at Wallester, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers and overseeing their work on complex projects. You will plan, organize, and direct the engineering work, ensuring on-time completion and quality outcomes. You will collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to meet project objectives and align engineering goals with business requirements. You will also be involved in developing new processes or procedures for your team, creating training programs, updating job descriptions, or establishing performance metrics.If you are passionate about fintech and payment solutions, have excellent technical skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you!


Technology stack

  • Golang
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • JSON REST API
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linkerd
  • AWS infrastructure
  • Microservice Architecture


What will you do?

  • Guide, coach and grow our team of outstanding Software Engineers
  • Provide technical leadership and direction, bridging the gap between the engineering team and senior management
  • Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to understand project requirements and optimize development resource allocation
  • Manage and prioritize development tasks to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality results
  • Jump into hands-on development when needed, helping the team in solving ongoing challenges
  • Continuously monitor and evaluate code quality and development output, identifying areas for improvement and working collaboratively to fix defects and issues
  • Actively contribute to adopting best practices in Software Engineering, improvement of processes, and team culture


What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in software development using any OOP language (C# / Java / PHP / etc)
  • 2+ years of experience in leading a software engineering team
  • Experience with microservices architecture, REST API, RPC, PostgreSQL, and Docker
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire team members
  • You have good English and communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you can adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Proficient in Agile methodologies and Scrum framework
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated experience in mentoring and coaching team members
  • Experience in working with cloud platforms (Azure / GCP / AWS)


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with DevOps principles and practices
  • Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and technologies for software engineering and delivery
  • Experience in test methodologies and frameworks
  • Experience in financial software development
  • Knowledge of security best practices and standards (OWASP, PCI DSS)
  • Also, a spark in the eyes is always a plus!


We offer

  • Competitive salary
  • The chance to work as part of a highly motivated and talented team
  • Development and career opportunities
  • Supportive and caring Leadership
  • A modern office in the center of Tallinn
  • Fresh fruit, sweets, drinks, and treats
  • Sports compensation
  • Great Team events
  • Free Parking

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Private IP addresses and Domain names

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:

  • Accept and handle technical requests.

  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.

Why Join JoVE?

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform, helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.


We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets. If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English, we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.


This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission, offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation). 
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas. 
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles. 
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro. 
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.). 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo. 
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission.
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.
  • Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR
description:
A epharma é uma das principais plataformas de gestão de benefícios de medicamentos no Brasil, conectando tecnologia e saúde de forma inovadora desde 1999. Como pioneira na criação do PBM – Plano de Benefícios de Medicamentos no país, a epharma atua como um elo estratégico entre indústrias farmacêuticas, farmácias, startups, setor público e empresas privadas de diversos segmentos. Com uma rede de mais de 42 mil farmácias e 2 mil clínicas e laboratórios de diagnóstico credenciados, a epharma já beneficiou mais de 32.9 milhões de pessoas, gerando uma economia superior a R$ 2.5 bilhões em 2024.

Estamos contratando PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR para oxigenar as conexões e impulsionar a saúde com a gente!

Descrição :

Atuar na área de Tecnologia Informação, exercendo a liderança técnica da equipe; assegurando a construção de algoritmos de alto desempenho, protótipos, modelos preditivos e provas de conceito; assegurando a criação de componentes personalizados de software e aplicações analíticas; fiscalizando a segurança dos dados e integridade das informações; liderando tecnicamente a colaboração com arquitetos de dados, modeladores e membros da equipe de TI, bem como realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo.


Responsabilidades :

  • Exercer a liderança técnica da equipe;
  • Assegurar a construção de algoritmos de alto desempenho, protótipos, modelos preditivos e provas de conceito;
  • Assegurar a criação de componentes personalizados de software e aplicações analíticas;
  • Fiscalizar a segurança dos dados e integridade das informações;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a colaboração com arquitetos de dados, modeladores e membros da equipe de TI sobre os objetivos do projeto;
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados que possibilitem o processamento, integração e coleta de dados de diversas fontes;
  • Integrar novas tecnologias de gerenciamento de dados e ferramentas de engenharia de software nas estruturas existentes;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a análise de dados e criar visualizações e relatórios, de modo a auxiliar a empresa na tomada de decisões com base em dados;
  • Instalar e atualizar os procedimentos de recuperação de desastres;
  • Recomendar formas de melhorar a confiabilidade dos dados, eficiência e qualidade;
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas e tecnologias de Big Data, como Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive e outras
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e científica.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica ou atuação como Tech Lead, Data Engineering Lead, Machine Learning Lead ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação aplicadas a dados e alta performance: Python, Scala e Pyspark .
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados , arquitetura de dados , ETL/ELT e construção de pipelines.
  • Vivência com tecnologias de Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais .
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação , governança de dados e conformidade (incluindo LGPD).
  • Experiência com ambientes on-premise , cloud ou híbridos.


Formação acadêmica :

Formação em Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Horário de trabalho: de segunda-feira a sexta-feira, das 09h às 18h, com uma hora de intervalor

Benefícios : Você decide o que é benefício para você! Oferecemos mais de 40 opções para você escolher e usar como quiser em nosso marketplace de benefícios.

Conheça todos os nosso benefícios incríveis:

Nossa cultura:

Nossa cultura é movida por ownership, resultado e inovação. Acreditamos que cada epharmer é protagonista de sua jornada e peça fundamental no alcance de nossos objetivos estratégicos. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde o empoderamento, a colaboração e a busca constante por soluções inovadoras são os pilares do nosso crescimento. Somos uma organização dinâmica, que valoriza as conexões inteligentes e o impacto real que criamos na vida das pessoas.

Aqui, cada resultado é compartilhado e cada avanço é celebrado. Nossa missão é desafiar o status quo, oxigenar conexões e impulsionar a saúde em todas as dimensões. Com transparência e confiança, incentivamos cada colaborador a ir além, assumindo a responsabilidade por suas entregas e construindo, juntos, um legado de transformação.

POR QUE FAZER PARTE DA EPHARMA?

Fazemos mais do que conectar pessoas à saúde. Construímos experiências que inspiram. Somos uma empresa certificada como GPTW e nosso compromisso vai além dos números: queremos ser referência em pessoas e resultados, inovando continuamente. Se você é movido(a) por desafios, acredita no poder da inovação e busca resultados com propósito, aqui é o seu lugar.

Junte-se ao propósito de transformar a saúde com inovação e protagonismo. Vem ser um epharmer!

title: Account Executive
description:
Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market , while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM .


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.


Main Responsibilities


1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing


  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).


2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io, CloudTalk, Instantly
  • Comm: Google Meet, Loom (for video demos), Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Parceiro(a) de Negócios - Energia Renovável
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A iGreen Energy é uma empresa brasileira inovadora de energia sustentável, fundada em 2021 em Uberlândia (MG), com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à energia solar limpa e renovável através de soluções de energia solar compartilhada e assinatura , sem a necessidade de investimento ou instalação de placas, oferecendo descontos na fatura de energia para residências e empresas.


A empresa atua com tecnologia, sustentabilidade e modelos de negócio escaláveis para tornar a energia limpa mais acessível e econômica, usando usinas de energia renovável próprias e de parceiros estratégicos para gerar créditos de energia para os clientes.


Em 2023, a Vibra Energia (antiga BR Distribuidora) adquiriu 50% da iGreen Energy como parte da estratégia de se tornar a maior plataforma multienergia do Brasil, viabilizando investimentos bilionários em capacidade energética para sustentar a expansão nacional, que está a pleno vapor.


Em 2025, a iGreen Energy atingiu uma das melhores notas do Reclame Aqui no setor de energia solar, e recebeu dessa plataforma a premiação de \"Melhor Empresa em Grandes Operações de Energia Solar de 2025\".


Descrição do Cargo

Estamos selecionando empreendedores e profissionais com perfil comercial para atuar na expansão nacional da iGreen Energy, vinculados à equipe comercial da iGreen Energy Vix, licenciada localizada em Vitória, Espírito Santo.


O objetivo é formar líderes que desejam construir um ativo financeiro sólido através de comissões recorrentes e vitalícias, com base nos pagamentos mensais das faturas de energia e telefonia móvel dos clientes conectados.

Devido à operação nacional da empresa, trata-se de uma oportunidade com total liberdade geográfica no setor que mais cresce no Brasil (Energia Renovável e Sustentabilidade).


As responsabilidades incluem prospectar e conectar clientes (pessoa física ou jurídica) às usinas de energia renovável da iGreen Energy e de seus parceiros, sem qualquer investimento por parte dos clientes, além de contribuir para a elaboração de novas estratégias de prospecção para potencializar o negócio e viabilizar o avanço no plano de carreira.


Qualificações

  • Planejamento e Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Habilidade de identificar oportunidades de mercado, criar estratégias de crescimento e construir parcerias comerciais.
  • Comunicação e Negociação: Habilidades sólidas para comunicação e negociação com diferentes stakeholders, assegurando alinhamento e efetividade nas interações com o mercado.
  • Conhecimento Básico e/ou Interesse do Setor de Energia Renovável: Buscamos parceiros que tenham interesse em se tornar especialistas em energia renovável, identificando a solução mais eficiente para cada perfil de cliente.
  • Analítico e Orientado para Resultados: Capacidade de analisar métricas de desempenho e propor melhorias estratégicas para alcançar metas organizacionais.
  • Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência na área comercial e/ou formação superior.


Por que se tornar um parceiro?

  • Modelo escalável: Comissões mensais recorrentes sobre o pagamento das faturas de energia e telefonia móvel da sua carteira de clientes.
  • Produto de alta demanda: Energia é um item essencial para empresas e famílias, representando um importante custo fixo mensal. A solução da iGreen Energy viabiliza pela primeira vez uma alternativa para redução de custos para os clientes conectados, sem qualquer obra ou investimento.
  • Diversidade de serviços: Possibilidade de comercializar projetos de energia fotovoltaica (placas) e conexão de grandes consumidores ao mercado livre de energia, com comissões ainda mais agressivas devido à complexidade das negociações.
  • Autonomia: Agenda totalmente flexível, com atuação 100% autônoma, ideal para quem já possui outra atividade ou busca transição de carreira.
  • Suporte completo: Acesso a CRM próprio, treinamentos semanais ao vivo, plataforma de treinamentos gravados e mentoria direta com a liderança.
  • Plano de carreira: Possibilidade de assumir um papel de liderança na empresa que mais cresce no mercado de energia por assinatura, com mais de 400 mil clientes conectados.

title: Product Designer Jr (AI / No-Code / App Builder)
description:
A Esfera é um dos estúdios de produtos mais prestigiados do Brasil, com atuação exclusiva no mercado americano, especialmente na Califórnia. Com um histórico de mais de 200 projetos concluídos e mais de $50M captados para nossos clientes, unimos design a um processo de desenvolvimento ultra-acelerado. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, criando soluções para gigantes como Microsoft, Google e Meta. Se você é movido por desafios, quer trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta e impactar o mercado digital com interfaces e apps de alto nível, seu lugar é aqui!


O que você fará?

Você será responsável por transformar ideias em produtos digitais reais, atuando desde a concepção até a construção e lançamento de apps. Na Esfera, design não é só visual: você desenha pensando em execução, valida rápido e constrói soluções funcionais em ciclos recordes com apoio de ferramentas modernas e IA.


Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Construir MVPs e aplicativos utilizando ferramentas como Lovable, Cursor e outras soluções AI / no-code / low-code;
  • Participar do processo completo: ideação, validação, build e launch;
  • Gerenciar suas próprias tarefas e prazos com autonomia, garantindo a excelência em cada entrega;
  • Transformar ideias complexas em interfaces intuitivas e prontas para o mercado;
  • Garantir que cada entrega reflita o padrão de excelência da Esfera, focando sempre no sucesso e na geração de receita para nossos clientes;
  • Identificar gargalos técnicos e propor soluções rápidas;
  • Colaboração ativa com a equipe em reuniões de alinhamento e brainstorming.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia com Figma;
  • Experiência prática como Product Designer, UX/UI Designer ou UX Engineer;
  • Domínio ou forte interesse em ferramentas AI / no-code / low-code;
  • INDISPENSÁVEL inglês Intermediário;
  • Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo (o cenário de IA muda toda semana);
  • Sólido conhecimento em UX e Produto Digital;
  • Proatividade e facilidade em trabalhar em equipe de forma remota.


Diferenciais:

  • Mentalidade de builder (gosta de executar, não só projetar);
  • Experiência prévia com Lovable, Cursor ou ferramentas similares;
  • Noções de lógica de programação, APIs ou desenvolvimento front-end;
  • Já ter lançado produtos reais (web ou app stores);
  • Interesse genuíno em novas modelos de construção de produto (AI-first);
  • Experiência em startups ou ambientes de construção rápida.


O que oferecemos?

  • Contratação PJ;
  • Plano de carreira e crescimento acelerado em um mercado global;
  • Horário semi flexível: 9h-13h (fixo) + 4h flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Encontro com o time anual 100% custeada pela Esfera;
  • Autonomia no trabalho e ambiente dinâmico;
  • Contrato inicial de experiência: 3 meses.


Venha fazer parte da Esfera e ajude a moldar o futuro do desenvolvimento de produtos!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Role Description:

The Network DevOps Engineer is responsible for supporting, implementing and securing the AWS network products which includes but not limited to VPC, Transit gateways, Route 53, ACM, ELB’s, AWS WAF. The Network DevOps Engineer will provide support and implement multiple projects in the AWS Network domain and will be responsible for delivering the projects based on timelines. The Network DevOps Engineer will also attend and expand his skillset by continuous learning and will work on an on- call schedule.

This position is part of the Infrastructure and Operations group and will be located remotely with some travel. At the infrastructure and operations group, we aim to deliver consistent, scalable, and reliable services to our end users and external customers. The network team within the infrastructure and operations organization is responsible for providing reliable network services and keep innovating on behalf of the end users and various business teams.

Job Experience Requirements:

· Expertise in multi-account and multi-region AWS environments, Organizations and Control Tower.

· Certifications: AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect is highly desirable.

· 3+ years’ experience in cloud networking (with direct AWS VPC experience mandatory)

· Utilize Jira and ticketing tools to track the Network related tasks. Understand and ensure the tasks are performed in accordance with audit & compliance policies.

· Solid understanding of IP networking, DNS, TCP/IP, and routing protocols (BGP, OSPF).

· Strong expertise with AWS core networking services: VPC, Route 53, ELB/NLB, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPNs, PrivateLink.

· Security configuration and incident response experience.

· Experience automating network management via IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation).

· Monitoring and troubleshooting experience with cloud-native and third-party tools (CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, Palo Alto/Cisco/Juniper SRX firewalls).

· Knowledge of container networking and Kubernetes (EKS/ECS).

Job Responsibilities:

  • Support and configure auto scaling, VPC, VPC endpoints, DHCP options sets, Prefix lists, Network ACL’s, Security groups, DNS firewall, AWS VPN, Transit gateways, Route 53, ACM, ELB’s, AWS WAF network products and make sure that build is as per the standard.
  • · Interact with a diverse client base and work collaboratively with others, learn and support new deployments and technologies, automate and improve processes and fix problems as they arise.
  • Configure & orchestrate based on best practices, documentation and business use cases.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Us

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer experienced in Azure Cloud operations to join our remote-first engineering team. This position suits someone who thrives in building and maintaining large-scale infrastructure, ensuring performance and reliability, and communicating effectively with both technical and client teams.

As a DevOps Engineer at Radity, you will manage, optimize, and automate Azure-based infrastructure. You will ensure the smooth operation of production systems, focusing on scalability, security, and monitoring. You will also work closely with developers and clients to provide technical clarity and maintain high service reliability.

  • Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure in Azure Cloud, including AKS environments.

title: Account Executive
description:
Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market , while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM .


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.


Main Responsibilities


1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing


  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).


2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io, CloudTalk, Instantly
  • Comm: Google Meet, Loom (for video demos), Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.

title: Integration Engineer - Developer n8n Specialist
description:
Location: Remote | Industry: Retail / E-commerce Technology


About the Mission

We are leading a strategic technological transformation at the heart of our retail operations. We are migrating our core automation and integration layer from Workato to a self-hosted n8n platform. This isn't just an update; it's a complete rebuild for scale, control, and performance.

We are looking for the lead engineer to own this critical migration and shape the future of how our enterprise systems—like RetailPro, SAP, Oracle, and Amazon S3—communicate and automate.

If you are a developer who thrives on complex integrations, enjoys the challenge of platform migration, and wants to see your architecture decisions power a high-volume business, this is your role.


Your Core Challenge

You will be the technical owner of the \"Workato to n8n\" migration project. Your primary mission is to design, execute, and optimize the new automation ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Migration: Architect and execute the full migration of complex automation workflows from Workato to a self-hosted n8n environment.
  • Build Enterprise Integrations: Develop, maintain, and optimize high-volume, reliable workflows connecting critical systems: RetailPro, SAP (ECC/S4HANA), Amazon S3, Oracle DB, Snowflake, and various APIs.
  • Ensure Robust Connectivity: Design and implement secure, reliable connectivity solutions between our n8n platform and on-premise systems.
  • Champion Reliability: Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve the performance and uptime of all automated processes.
  • Own the Platform: Make key decisions on the n8n deployment, scaling, and best practices, acting as the subject-matter expert.


Who We Are Looking For

Must-Have Skills (Non-negotiable):

  • 3+ years of hands-on, production experience with n8n. You have built, deployed, and maintained complex workflows.
  • Proven experience with self-hosted n8n deployments. You understand the infrastructure, scaling, and security aspects.
  • Direct experience migrating from one iPaaS platform to another, preferably from Workato, Zapier, or Make. You know the pitfalls and patterns of platform migration.
  • Strong understanding of secure integration patterns for on-premise systems (e.g., via SSH tunnels, VPN, agents).
  • Experience with event-driven and file-based automation architectures.

Highly Valued Skills (Nice-to-Have):

  • Development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for writing custom n8n nodes or logic.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, IAM).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for n8n deployments.
  • Familiarity with RetailPro, SAP B1/ECC, or Oracle E-Business Suite from an integration perspective.


  • Why You Should ApplyOwn a Strategic Project: This is not a maintenance role. You will own and define a migration that is critical to business operations.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Work on challenging integrations that move data between the core systems of a major retailer.
  • Technical Autonomy: You will be the expert. We trust you to make the right technical decisions and shape the platform's future.
  • Growth & Impact: Your work will directly influence operational efficiency and provide visible value across the company.
  • Modern Stack: Work with a leading, developer-friendly automation tool (n8n) in a modern, cloud-aware context.


Salary: 5000USD

title: LATAM Customer Success Manager
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Overview:

Prometheus Group’s Customer Success Department is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our growing team. In this role you will be responsible for understanding our customer base, increasing customer engagement and retention. You will connect with our customer base daily to identify key stakeholders and establish a collaborative relationship between our organization and our customers’. We’re looking for individuals who share our passion for understanding our customers’ needs, anticipating gaps, and elaborating engagement strategies to provide solutions. In this position you will work across departments with our Sales, Support, Development, Marketing, Finance, and Deliveries teams alike to nurture our customer base and stimulate the growth of our Prometheus Platform with each customer.


Responsibilities:

  • Forge relationships with new customers and understand their objectives
  • From a consultative approach, develop an engagement strategy and plan for achieving customer objectives in any part of the customer journey to ensure churn prevention
  • Represent the voice of the customer to provide input into every core product, marketing, and sales process
  • Monitor customer usage, adoption, and customer health metrics
  • Continually work with customers per prescribed engagement model to support ongoing successful adoption of the Prometheus Platform and to drive additional value throughout the lifetime of the subscription term
  • Perform periodic business reviews with customers (virtual and on-site) to confirm satisfaction, resolve technical issues, and continually drive successful product adoption
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that will improve the overall customer experience and lead to greater satisfaction and loyalty among customers
  • Leverage new and existing tools, processes and best practices to ensure customers are realizing the greatest possible value from the Prometheus Platform
  • Be proactive when conducting discovery with customers on opportunities and handle any objections to ensure predictability of successfully closing those opportunities
  • Generate and manage your assigned account pipeline via weekly and daily forecasts as well as reviewing with your direct manager
  • Measured on engagement volume
  • Maintain impeccable administration of your accounts in the Company's CRM


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience and education preferred
  • Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese
  • Experience with MS Office (Word and Excel)
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM preferred
  • Familiarity with standard concepts, practices and procedures with software implementation and rollout
  • Ambitious self-starter with high energy, passion, drive, and motivation
  • Excellent verbal and written communications
  • Excellent time management and organization skills
  • Superior customer service skills
  • Strong collaborative and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision
  • Ability to build rapport with customers via phone, email and video conferencing


What’ll make you stand out?!

  • ERP system experience (Oracle, SAP)
  • Experience in the software industry
  • Functional understanding of plant maintenance workflow, including both routine and shut down/turnaround maintenance.
  • Prior Customer Success Management is a plus


Prometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Physical Therapist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Therapist to join our team.


If you have a passion for improving lives through exercise, certifications in sports medicine or orthopedic expertise, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate has a minimum of 3 years of experience, along with additional certifications, and is proficient in advanced English.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity for career advancement and professional growth.
  • Full-time position with the flexibility to work from a home office.
  • Engaging work environment with deep human interaction, focused on patient care.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on patients' health and well-being.


Salary:

  • After a paid initial 4 month intensive education and on-boarding process which is paid at 1st month 1st month: R$3,100, 2nd month: R$4,650, 3rd month: R$6,200, 4th month: R$7,750. After one year, there will be an opportunity to increase your income beyond R$9,300, with most team members eventually earning over R$7,750 per month.
  • After your first year with us you will have additional benefits of 2 weeks paid vacation, health insurance, and retirement funds.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency for clear communication.
  • Ability to effectively convey exercise techniques.
  • Sports medicine or Orthopedic expertise to address specific needs and limitations.
  • Additional certifications showcasing your commitment to professional growth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Outgoing personality to motivate and engage patients.
  • Continuous training mindset to stay updated with industry advancements.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage patient progress and programs.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and provide feedback on personalized exercise programs for patients.
  • Utilize your teaching background to educate and empower patients.
  • Leverage orthopedic expertise to design safe and effective exercise routines.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support for patients' fitness journeys.
  • Maintain open and effective communication with patients.


Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where continuous training and deep human interaction are valued.


Employment Type

Full-time

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.
